### Ameris Bank Joins National Partnership to Recruit Military Spouses


11/10/2026


[Download this Press Release (opens in new window) PDF 207 KB](https://s205.q4cdn.com/432887073/files/doc_news/Ameris-Bank-Joins-National-Partnership-to-Recruit-Military-Spouses-2026.pdf)


ATLANTA--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Ameris Bank has joined the Military Spouse Employer Partnership, a federal recruiting initiative that connects military spouses with employers. The partnership is part of SpouseWorks, which helps military spouses pursue education and career opportunities.


Through the partnership, Ameris Bank will highlight job openings across its markets and help military spouses find and apply for roles that match their skills and experience. Opportunities span retail banking, operations, technology, customer support, risk management, finance and other areas of the bank.


“Frequent moves can make it hard for military spouses to build a career,” said Palmer Proctor, CEO of Ameris Bank. “We want to make it easier for them to find opportunities at Ameris. Military spouses bring skills and experience we value, and we look forward to meeting more of them through this partnership.”


For more information about career opportunities at Ameris Bank, visit the bank’s[careers page](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.amerisbank.com%2FAbout%2FCareers&esheet=54638664&newsitemid=20261110881522&lan=en-US&anchor=careers+page&index=1&md5=202904d9e1bd7f4ace7c00873079200f) .


**About Ameris Bank**


Ameris Bank, a subsidiary of Ameris Bancorp (NYSE: ABCB), is a state-chartered bank headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. Ameris operates financial centers in five southeastern states and serves consumer and business customers nationwide through select lending channels. Ameris manages $28.5 billion in assets as of September 30, 2026, and provides a full range of traditional banking and lending products, treasury and cash management, insurance premium financing, and mortgage and refinancing services. Learn more about Ameris at[amerisbank.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.amerisbank.com&esheet=54638664&newsitemid=20261110881522&lan=en-US&anchor=amerisbank.com&index=2&md5=20a2b3b89bc8cbf34f8d57052fe60a59) .
